text:
maria: kicking off a latency sweep comparing replay-harness vs synthetic traffic. toggling kernel-selection heuristics + batch caps. will post quick hits.
aj: awesome — which config are you starting with? batch_cap=32? max_delay=6ms?
kevin: starting with baseline: batch_cap=16, max_delay=8ms, kernel_policy=auto. command:
```
./harness/run_sweep --mode=replay --batch-cap=16 --max-delay-ms=8 --kernel=auto --warm-kv=1
```
sara: note: replay has a lot of prefix-locality; kv-cache warm paths will look much better than synth. mark cold-warm in the logs please.
maria: yep we'll tag runs with `warm_kv=true/false`. first two runs: warm=true for both replay/synth.
jamal: quick heads up, last night i saw p99 spikes when kernel_policy switched from auto->favor-small-batches on the 40a nodes.
kevin: confirmed. small-batch kernels lower average latency but increase kernel-switch overhead under microbursts. saw ~12% p95 regress on mixed-tenancy tests.
maria: interim numbers (warm): replay p50=28ms p95=92ms p99=180ms; synth p50=32ms p95=110ms p99=210ms. enabling `favor-small-batches` -> p95 down 8% for single-tenant but p99 up 14% in multi-tenant.
sara: are batch sizes actually smaller when that kernel is chosen? can you paste the profiler snippet?
kevin: profiler snippet (abbrev):
```
kernel_switches: 124
avg_batch_size: 9.2
kv_cache_hit: 0.83
queue_delay_avg_ms: 4.7
```
maria: curious thing: when we bump max_delay to 12ms p99 drops a bit for replay but avg tail cost goes up — looks like larger batches reduce per-token cost but can hurt fairness.
jamal: that's the fairness tradeoff — tenants with low QPS get aggregated into big batches and see extra queueing delay.
aj: any ideas for per-tenant knobs? per-tenant max_delay or delay-cap weight?
sara: we tried per-tenant delay-cap in the alpha infra: small tenants had max_delay=4ms, big tenants 12ms. cut p99 for small tenants ~30% at cost of slight throughput drop.
kevin: suggestion: adaptive delay-cap based on recent arrival rate (exponential EWMA). code sketch:
```
if ewma_qps(tenant) < 0.5 * global_qps:
  max_delay = clamp(ewma_qps * 50ms, 2ms, 6ms)
else:
  max_delay = default_max_delay
```
maria: can we run a quick apples-to-apples: replay vs synth with adaptive-delay on? also toggle kernel_policy auto vs favor-small.
loadtest-bot: queued job 5903 started (sweep: replay|synth x kernel_policy x delay_policy). ETA ~25m :hourglass:.
kevin: quick note — watch KV cache interplay: adaptive-delay increased kv_cache_hit for small tenants (more coalescing) which masked kernel switch costs.
aj: action items: 1) run sweep with adaptive-delay + kernel auto, 2) capture per-tenant p50/p95/p99 + avg batch sizes, 3) produce a 1-page note calling out any regressions and recommended default knobs.
maria: assigning 1->kevin, 2->sara, 3->maria. I'll post the summary when loadtest-bot finishes.
kevin: copying the command i'm running now:
```
./harness/run_sweep --modes=replay,synth --kernel=auto,favor-small --delay-policy=adaptive --log-tags=tenant_stats,warm_kv
```
sara: i'll prep a small notebook to aggregate the per-tenant CSVs into the fairness charts.
maria: thanks all. if we see a p99 regression >15% for any tenant we rollback kernel change and iterate on adaptive parameters. :thumbsup:
loadtest-bot: job 5903 completed — results uploaded to /runs/5903/artifacts (summary.json, per_tenant/*.csv).
